critical_code_review_comments: services/home_audio_v2_seed.py:76 — seed only writes the flagship_boost_activations row when the station document exists in imported_radio_stations. That's defensive but means a fresh mongo without the flagship import would silently skip the sponsored slot with no visible error. Add a WARN log when station is missing so the missing-import case is loud during preview bring-up.

routes/admin_ad_revenue.py:52-63 — the counters use count_documents which is fine for correctness but on hot data a single $facet aggregation over live_radio_ad_impressions + banner_ad_impressions + listening_heartbeat_minutes would cut round-trips from 4 to 1. Non-blocking for current volume.

routes/admin_ad_revenue.py:78 — estimated_revenue_cents mixes cent-scaled CPMs; the /1000.0 division then round() is fine, but the field name would be clearer as 'estimated_revenue_cents_est' or accompany a 'basis' string so admins downstream do not treat it as billed. UI already labels it 'Est. Revenue' so acceptable.

routes/admin_ad_revenue.py:62 — listening_heartbeat_minutes filter uses {'created_at': {'$gte': since}} but the listening block itself calls out that TTL is ~24h. Consider surfacing a 'window_effective_hours' hint (e.g. min(days*24, 24)) so admins running 30d don't think listening is under-reporting.
